name: Christmas
source:
A short visual novel about a girl Jennifer, who hates Christmas because on the very day of Christmas, her brother took his final breaths in this world.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=9179]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一部关于女孩珍妮弗的短篇视觉小说。她憎恨圣诞节，因为哥哥正是在圣诞节当天咽下了最后一口气。

[引自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=9179]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
